ideas.pitch: A modular desk organizer crafted entirely from discarded plastic bottles and cardboard scrap.
ideas.problem_statement: The Junior Makethon challenges school students to use their engineering creativity and resourcefulness to address the problem of modern-day waste generation.
ideas.title: EcoDesk Caddy
ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges in a rapid 90-minute upcycling challenge prioritize immediate functional utility and structural stability over purely artistic pieces.
